title: Merge K Sorted Arrays
description: Given `k` sorted arrays each of size `n`, merge them into a single sorted array.
input_format: First line contains `k` and `n`. Following `k` lines contain `n` integers each.
hints: Use a min-heap storing the smallest element of each array along with its source index.
Extract min and push the next element from that array into heap.
Achieves O(N log k) time where N = k * n.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    k, n = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    all_nums = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+k*n]]
    all_nums.sort()
    print(' '.join(map(str, all_nums)))
